macro.headline: ASX navigates sticky inflation and cautious rate outlook amidst firm commodity prices and geopolitical undercurrents.
themes: Inflation Persistence & Rate Uncertainty: Global inflation data (esp. US PCE) will dictate market sentiment on future rate cuts, with 'higher for longer' still a dominant narrative.
Commodity Resilience: Geopolitical tensions and steady demand are keeping energy (oil, LNG) and precious metals (gold) prices firm, offering support to related sectors.
China's Gradual Recovery: Latest Chinese economic data (PMIs) will be crucial for assessing demand for key Australian exports like iron ore and other base metals.
Consumer Headwinds: High interest rates and cost-of-living pressures continue to weigh on domestic consumer confidence and discretionary spending.
